notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We’re thrilled to introduce Patch 1.1, bringing some exciting new features and updates to enhance your gameplay! Your feedback has been instrumental in shaping these changes, and we can’t wait to hear what you think. Here’s what’s new:

New Features and Updates:

Game Over Indicator:
We’ve added a new indicator to the progress bar that warns players when a game over is approaching. This feature will help you stay on top of your strategy and guide you toward the trash chute to avoid disaster!

Save Game Option:
That’s right—saving your game is now possible! But don’t get too comfortable—saving comes at a cost, and it’s up to you to decide when it’s worth the investment.

Furniture Shopping in the Bar Book:
Spruce up your space! Players can now purchase furniture directly from the bar book. Whether it’s style or practicality you’re after, your hotel just got a whole lot more customizable.

Warm regards,
The Dev Team

notes.title: Third hotfix!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We’re back with HotFix #3 Here's what’s new:

What’s New:
Antique Collection Descriptions:
Each item in Uncle’s antique collection now comes with detailed descriptions, including how they influence gameplay. Dive deeper into the lore and strategy behind these unique items!

Visible Antique Collection in the Lobby:
The full collection is now showcased in the hotel lobby. Initially grayed out, items will appear permanently as you discover them, making the lobby feel more alive and rewarding.

Improved Voice-Overs (VO):
We've updated and refined the voice-over lines for a more polished and engaging narrative experience.

Subtitle Timing Adjustments:
Subtitle display times have been fine-tuned to match the pacing of dialogues better, ensuring no line is missed or rushed.

Your feedback continues to shape the game, and we’re thrilled to bring these improvements to you.

Thank you for being part of this journey and for helping us make the game even better.

Warm regards,
The Dev Team

notes.title: Second hotfix is here!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

HotFix #2 is here. This included:
Fixes and Improvements:

Rebalanced Gameplay: We've adjusted penalties for quests and guest interactions to ensure fairer gameplay.
Rat Icons Added: New rat icons have been added to the floor panel for better visualization and management.
Rat Population Adjustments: The number of rats per floor has been recalibrated, and the chance of rat multiplication has been significantly reduced.
Guest Book Decline Fix: Resolved the issue with the "Decline" button disappearing from the guest book.
Improved Draw Panels: The randomization panels have been enhanced for smoother and more consistent performance.

Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, don’t hesitate to share your thoughts or report any issues.

Thank you for playing!

Warm regards,
The Dev Team

notes.title: First HotFix is here!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

The first hot fix is here! Based on your feedback! 
Here’s what’s included in this patch:

Fixes:
Relationship Level Adjustments: The relationship thresholds at 20, 40, and 60 now work as intended when starting a new game.
Difficulty Levels Names: The names of difficulty levels have been clarified for better understanding.
Guest Book and Quest Time Skipping: Resolved issues with the guest book and time-skipping during quests.
New Game with Tutorial: Starting a new game now properly integrates the tutorial for a smoother onboarding experience.
We truly appreciate your patience and support as we continue to enhance the game. Stay tuned for more updates coming soon! If you encounter any further issues, please don't hesitate to share them with us.

Thank you for playing and being part of this journey!

Warm regards,
The Dev Team
